Mission Local reported that MEDA was purchasing a four-story building at 2901 16th St., on the corner of South Van Ness Avenue, to convert into 62 units of permanent affordable housing. The building is two blocks east of the 16th Street BART station. Its tenants could stay or move out during rehabilitation. The purchase depended on city approval of a loan.
